evidence_proposition: With three environments and the multivariate-block space-dummy mode, J-PCMCI+ reports the declared algorithm, at least two nodes and one link, the multivariate diagnostic, and no more than one logical space-dummy id.
limitations: Library-only structural pin; no external multivariate space-dummy oracle exists for it. Does not establish discovery accuracy, error control or calibration.
